verdict.rationale: Greptile's own security page reserves the right to aggregate and anonymize customer data and use it to train AI models, and the pack documents no opt-out for the hosted service. Users can keep data out of reach only through workarounds: self-hosting in their own VPC or air-gapped environment, using their own or self-hosted LLMs, and turning off logging so chats stay private, with self-hosted logs stored only on customer servers. Missing for 10: an explicit no-training guarantee or opt-out toggle for the hosted service, a contractual commitment covering de-identified data, and independent corroboration.
